title: A Table Every Friday  (Uma mesa toda sexta-feira)

segments.t: Depois que os aplausos dão lugar a uma conversa animada, Caleb e Owen se sentam em uma pequena mesa do pátio sob a árvore enquanto Tessa traz rolinhos de canela quentinhos. Vamos ouvir primeiro.
Two warm cinnamon rolls as my gift for my best soup-and-bread crew!
Sit down for a minute, Tessa—Caleb has big news to tell us.
Wait—don't tell me your Saturday morning train was cancelled, Caleb!
Better: I am only taking that train to pack my boxes and move back.
Tell Tessa what you signed on Linden Street this afternoon, little brother!
There was an empty ground-floor studio four doors past the bakery.
No way! You are opening your acoustic design studio on our street?!
By day I draw quiet rooms, and after City Hall Owen brings Grandfather's wood tools!
Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and panels together!
Then I am reserving this exact courtyard table for you two every Friday at six!
Put it in Graham's paper book in permanent ink, Tessa!
From a swapped blue suitcase on Monday to neighbours for good!
Agora vamos revisar linha por linha com a tradução em português.
Two warm cinnamon rolls as my gift for my best soup-and-bread crew!
'Dois rolinhos de canela quentinhos de presente para a minha melhor equipe de sopa e pão!'
Sit down for a minute, Tessa—Caleb has big news to tell us.
'Sente-se um minuto, Tessa — o Caleb tem uma grande novidade para nos contar.'
Wait—don't tell me your Saturday morning train was cancelled, Caleb!
'Espere — não me diga que o seu trem da manhã de sábado foi cancelado, Caleb!'
Better: I am only taking that train to pack my boxes and move back.
'Melhor ainda: só vou pegar aquele trem para empacotar minhas caixas e voltar de vez.'
Tell Tessa what you signed on Linden Street this afternoon, little brother!
'Conte para a Tessa o que você assinou na Rua Linden hoje à tarde, irmãozinho!'
There was an empty ground-floor studio four doors past the bakery.
'Havia um estúdio térreo vazio quatro portas depois da padaria.'
No way! You are opening your acoustic design studio on our street?!
'Não é possível! Você vai abrir seu estúdio de design acústico na nossa rua?!'
By day I draw quiet rooms, and after City Hall Owen brings Grandfather's wood tools!
'De dia eu desenho salas silenciosas, e depois da Prefeitura o Owen traz as ferramentas de marcenaria do avô!'
Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and panels together!
'Às noites e nos fins de semana, vamos construir mesas e painéis de madeira juntos!'
Then I am reserving this exact courtyard table for you two every Friday at six!
'Então eu vou reservar esta exata mesa do pátio para vocês dois toda sexta-feira às seis!'
Put it in Graham's paper book in permanent ink, Tessa!
'Coloque no livro de papel do Graham com tinta permanente, Tessa!'
From a swapped blue suitcase on Monday to neighbours for good!
'De uma mala azul trocada na segunda-feira a vizinhos para sempre!'
Agora vamos ouvir a conversa inteira uma última vez.

Sit down for a minute, Tessa—Caleb has big news to tell us.
Wait—don't tell me your Saturday morning train was cancelled, Caleb!
Better: I am only taking that train to pack my boxes and move back.
Tell Tessa what you signed on Linden Street this afternoon, little brother!
There was an empty ground-floor studio four doors past the bakery.
No way! You are opening your acoustic design studio on our street?!
By day I draw quiet rooms, and after City Hall Owen brings Grandfather's wood tools!
Evenings and weekends, we are building wooden tables and panels together!
Then I am reserving this exact courtyard table for you two every Friday at six!
Put it in Graham's paper book in permanent ink, Tessa!
From a swapped blue suitcase on Monday to neighbours for good!
Dois irmãos que mal se falavam há duas semanas agora dividem o projeto de um estúdio bem ali na rua — com uma mesa fixa às sextas debaixo da árvore! Até a próxima.
See you next time.
